product_overview: Collabdoc is a real-time collaborative document editor that lets users create, edit, share, and manage rich-text documents with live presence and conflict-free synchronization. It is built for production-style collaboration with offline support, document permissions, and version history.
core_goals: Enable zero-conflict real-time collaboration across multiple users in the same document.
Support offline editing with automatic merge on reconnect and no manual conflict resolution.
Provide secure authentication, session persistence, and role-based document access.
Deliver fast document loading, low-latency sync, and reliable persistence of document state.
Offer document management capabilities including create, rename, trash, restore, duplicate, and search.
Support live presence features such as cursors, avatars, typing indicators, and collaborator counts.
Maintain auditable version history with preview, diff, and restore capabilities.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows visitors to sign up or sign in and authenticated users to maintain a persistent session across the app.
user_flows: GET /api/auth/signin to load the sign-in page -> POST /api/auth/signin with valid credentials -> Receive 200 and set session cookie -> GET /api/auth/session with cookie -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> GET /dashboard -> Receive 200 and dashboard content
GET /api/auth/signin to load the sign-in page -> POST /api/auth/signin with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 auth error -> GET /dashboard without session -> Receive 302 redirect to /signin
GET /api/auth/session without a valid cookie -> Receive 401 or unauthenticated session response -> GET /signin -> Receive 200 and sign-in UI

features.name: User Profile and Settings
features.description: Lets authenticated users view and update their profile details such as display name and avatar.
user_flows: GET /api/users/me with a valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with current user profile -> PATCH /api/users/me with a valid name update -> Receive 200 with updated profile -> GET /api/users/me -> Receive 200 with saved changes
GET /api/users/me without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> PATCH /api/users/me with no session -> Receive 401 unauthorized
PATCH /api/users/me with an empty or overly long name -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /settings -> Receive 200 and show unchanged profile state

features.name: Dashboard and Document Management
features.description: Provides the authenticated dashboard for listing, creating, opening, searching, starring, trashing, restoring, duplicating, and permanently deleting documents.
user_flows: GET /api/documents with a valid session and default query params -> Receive 200 with active document list -> POST /api/documents with a title -> Receive 201 with new document -> GET /api/documents/:id -> Receive 200 with document metadata -> GET /dashboard -> Receive 200 and show the new document

GET /api/documents?search=plan&status=ACTIVE with a valid session -> Receive 200 with filtered results -> PATCH /api/documents/:id with {"title":"Q3 Planning"} as owner -> Receive 200 with updated document -> PATCH /api/documents/:id with {"status":"TRASHED"} as owner -> Receive 200 with trashed document -> GET /trash -> Receive 200 and show trashed document

GET /api/documents without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/documents without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /dashboard without session -> Receive 302 redirect to /signin

PATCH /api/documents/:id with invalid title payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> DELETE /api/documents/:id while document is still ACTIVE -> Receive 409 conflict because document must be trashed first -> GET /api/documents/:id for a non-existent id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Realtime Collaborative Editor
features.description: Enables multiple authenticated users to edit the same rich-text document simultaneously with Yjs-backed conflict-free synchronization and live room-based collaboration.
user_flows: GET /api/documents/:id with permission to open the document -> Receive 200 with metadata and role -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 200 and mount the editor -> Socket event authenticate with valid session token -> Receive authenticated -> Socket event join-room with documentId -> Receive sync-init and awareness-init -> Send yjs-update while typing -> Receive broadcast yjs-update on other clients

GET /api/documents/:id with permission to open the document -> Receive 200 with metadata -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 200 -> Socket event authenticate with valid token -> Receive authenticated -> Socket event join-room with documentId -> Receive sync-init -> Socket event yjs-update from another editor -> Receive remote content merged into local document

GET /api/documents/:id without permission -> Receive 403 forbidden -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 403 or access-denied state -> Socket event join-room with unauthorized documentId -> Receive room-error with permission failure

Socket event authenticate with expired or invalid token -> Receive auth-error -> Socket event join-room after failed auth -> Receive room-error or disconnect -> Editor remains read-only or disconnected

features.name: Live Presence and Cursor Awareness
features.description: Shows who is currently viewing or editing a document, including avatars, names, cursor locations, typing state, and join/leave notifications.
user_flows: Socket event authenticate with valid token -> Receive authenticated -> Socket event join-room with documentId -> Receive awareness-update for current collaborators -> Move cursor in editor -> Send awareness-update -> Other connected clients receive remote cursor position and user name label

Socket event awareness-update with cursor and typing state -> Receive broadcast awareness-update on peers -> Another user disconnects -> Receive user-left event -> Presence avatars update to remove the departed user
Socket event join-room without being in the document room -> Receive room-error -> Presence state is not shared to unauthorized user
Socket event awareness-update with malformed payload -> Receive room-error or ignored update -> Existing presence state remains unchanged

features.name: Document Sharing and Permissions
features.description: Allows owners to invite collaborators, generate share links, change collaborator roles, revoke access, and enforce view/edit permissions.
user_flows: POST /api/documents/:id/share/link as owner with permission VIEW -> Receive 201 with shareUrl -> GET /d/[documentId]?token=... as anonymous user -> Receive 200 with view-only access -> GET /api/documents/:id -> Receive 200 with myRole indicating access level

POST /api/documents/:id/collaborators as owner with collaborator email and role EDITOR -> Receive 200 or 201 with collaborator added -> PATCH /api/documents/:id/collaborators/:userId with role VIEWER -> Receive 200 with updated role -> DELETE /api/documents/:id/collaborators/:userId -> Receive 204 and collaborator access revoked
POST /api/documents/:id/share/link without owner permission -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/documents/:id/collaborators as non-owner -> Receive 403 forbidden

GET /api/documents/:id as viewer -> Receive 200 metadata with myRole VIEWER -> Attempt edit-related PATCH /api/documents/:id with title change -> Receive 403 insufficient permissions -> Attempt to send editor yjs-update in a viewer session -> Receive room-error or read-only enforcement

features.name: Version History, Diff, and Restore
features.description: Provides saved versions of documents, read-only previews, comparison between versions, and the ability to restore a prior version with backup creation.
user_flows: GET /api/documents/:id/versions -> Receive 200 with version list -> GET /api/documents/:id/versions/:versionId -> Receive 200 with read-only version preview -> GET /api/documents/:id/versions/:versionId/diff?compareWith=:otherVersionId -> Receive 200 with diff output

POST /api/documents/:id/versions/:versionId/restore as editor -> Receive 200 with restoredVersion and backupVersion -> GET /api/documents/:id/versions -> Receive 200 and see new backup version entry -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 200 and editor reflects restored content
GET /api/documents/:id/versions without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/documents/:id/versions/:versionId/restore as viewer -> Receive 403 forbidden
GET /api/documents/:id/versions/:versionId/diff with invalid version ids -> Receive 404 not found or 422 validation error

features.name: Persistence, Offline Editing, and Recovery
features.description: Keeps document state durable through IndexedDB on the client and snapshot persistence on the server, including offline edits and reconnect recovery.
user_flows: GET /api/documents/:id -> Receive 200 metadata -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 200 and load editor -> Socket event sync-init -> Receive latest Yjs snapshot -> Edit content online -> Receive save-status saved after debounced persistence

GET /d/[documentId] while offline after a prior successful load -> Editor continues locally with IndexedDB state -> Reconnect socket and send join-room -> Receive sync-init with missing updates -> Send pending yjs-update queue -> Receive save-status saved after merge

POST /api/documents/:id with authenticated session but invalid document payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> Socket event yjs-update with oversized or malformed binary payload -> Receive room-error and document state is preserved
GET /api/documents/:id after browser refresh -> Receive 200 metadata -> GET /d/[documentId] -> Receive 200 and restored content from persisted snapshot -> Save-status transitions from saving to saved

routes.description: Public landing page of the collaborative editor.
Sign-up page to register a new user.
User dashboard listing their documents, with actions to create or delete documents.
Realtime collaborative rich-text document editor page powered by Yjs, Tiptap, and Socket.io.
Deleted documents page with restore options.
